title.pinyin: Liú lǎoshī ràng wǒ gàosu nǐ
title.english: Professor Liu asked me to tell you

instruction.hanzi: 读一读，说说这些词语是什么意思。

the black one
too expensive

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Fúwùyuán, wǒmen sān ge rén.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, zhèbian qǐng. Xiànzài diǎn cài ma?
dialogue.english: Sure, this way please. Would you like to order now?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我们还有一个朋友没到，十分钟以后再点菜，好吗？

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de. Nǐmen xiān hē diǎnr chá ba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxie! Wǒ qù ménkǒu zhǎozhao tā.
dialogue.english: Thanks! I'll go and look for him at the door.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Wèi, Ānnà, nǐ zài zuò shénme ne?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 我在家看书呢。有什么事情吗？

dialogue.hanzi: 刘老师让我告诉你，明天的考试是下午两点。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 星期六早上，我想去打篮球。

dialogue.pinyin: Kànle yí ge xiǎoshí shū yǐhòu, wǒ qù zhǎo péngyou.
dialogue.english: After an hour of reading, I went to find my friends.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Tāmen dōu zài děng wǒ ne!
dialogue.english: They were all waiting for me!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我们一起打了两个小时篮球，真高兴！
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ dǎle liǎng ge xiǎoshí lánqiú, zhēn gāoxìng!

explanation.hanzi: 先说一个建议或者请求，再在后面加上“，好吗？”，问对方同意不同意。这样说比较客气。同意可以回答“好”“好的”“好啊”；不同意的时候，常常说明原因。
explanation.english:
First make a suggestion or request, then add "，好吗?" at the end to ask whether the other person agrees: "..., OK?" / "..., all right?". It sounds polite and friendly, not like an order. To agree, answer 好, 好的 or 好啊. To disagree, people usually give a reason rather than a flat 不好.
可以吗? works the same way when asking for permission.

examples.hanzi: 我们明天一起去买衣服，好吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān yìqǐ qù mǎi yīfu, hǎo ma?
examples.english: Let's go clothes shopping together tomorrow, OK?

examples.hanzi: 你晚上给我打电话，好吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wǎnshang gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà, hǎo ma?
examples.english: Give me a call tonight, will you?

examples.hanzi: 十分钟以后再点菜，好吗？
examples.pinyin: Shí fēnzhōng yǐhòu zài diǎn cài, hǎo ma?
examples.english: We'll order in ten minutes, if that's all right?

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ gàosu tā, hǎo ma? — Hǎo de.
examples.english: Could you tell him, please? — Sure.

explanation.hanzi: “再”放在动词前面，表示一个动作以后还会重复或者继续，多用于还没发生的事情：明天再来。“先……，再……”表示两个动作的先后，意思是“然后”。“再见”的“再”也是这个意思。注意：已经重复了的动作一般不用“再”，以后会学“又”。
explanation.english:
再 goes before the verb and means "again, once more" or "some more", about something that has NOT happened yet: 明天再来 "come again tomorrow". 再见 literally means "see (you) again".
In "先 ..., 再 ..." it means "then, after that" and puts two actions in order: 先吃饭，再看电影 "eat first, then watch the film". It can also mean "put it off until later": 十分钟以后再点菜.
For a repetition that has already happened, Chinese uses a different word (又), which you will learn later.

examples.hanzi: 这个菜很好吃，我想再吃一点儿。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cài hěn hǎochī, wǒ xiǎng zài chī yìdiǎnr.
examples.english: This dish is delicious. I'd like to have a bit more.

examples.hanzi: 他今天不在，你明天再来吧。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān bú zài, nǐ míngtiān zài lái ba.
examples.english: He's not in today. Come back tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 我们先吃饭，再去看电影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān chī fàn, zài qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: Let's eat first and then go and see the film.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zài shuō yíxià, hǎo ma?
examples.english: Could you say that once more, please?

explanation.hanzi: “A＋让＋B＋动词短语”表示A要求B做一件事情，或者A允许B做一件事情。B是“让”的宾语，也是后面动词的主语，所以叫“兼语”。否定形式是“A不让B……”，表示不允许。
explanation.english:
"A + 让 + B + verb phrase" means A asks / tells B to do something, or A lets B do it. B plays two roles at once: it is the object of 让 and the subject of the next verb. That is why it is called a "pivotal" sentence: B is the pivot.
妈妈让我看书: Mom tells me (me) to read.
The negative 不让 means "not allow": 爸爸不让我看电视 "Dad doesn't let me watch TV".

examples.hanzi: 妈妈让我早一点儿回家。
examples.pinyin: Māma ràng wǒ zǎo yìdiǎnr huí jiā.
examples.english: Mom wants me to come home a little early.
The doctor told him to rest more.

examples.pinyin: Liú lǎoshī ràng wǒmen xiě Hànzì.
examples.english: Ms. Liu had us write Chinese characters.

examples.hanzi: 爸爸不让我晚上看电视。
examples.pinyin: Bàba bú ràng wǒ wǎnshang kàn diànshì.
examples.english: Dad doesn't let me watch TV in the evening.

explanation.hanzi: 有的动词可以重叠，表示动作时间短、次数少，或者表示“试一试”，语气比较轻松、客气。单音节动词：AA（想想、看看）或者A一A（看一看）；双音节动词：ABAB（休息休息、介绍介绍）。说已经发生的事情用“A了A”：想了想。第二个音节常常读轻声。
explanation.english:
Many action verbs can be doubled to mean "do it a little, briefly, or just to try". It makes requests and suggestions sound relaxed and polite.
- One-syllable verbs: AA (想想, 看看) or A一A (看一看).
- Two-syllable verbs: ABAB (休息休息, 介绍介绍), never AABB.
- For something already done, use A了A: 我想了想 "I thought it over for a moment".
The repeated syllable is usually said lightly (neutral tone).

examples.hanzi: 你看一看这件衣服，怎么样？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn yi kàn zhè jiàn yīfu, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: Take a look at this top. What do you think?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ tài máng le, xiūxi xiūxi ba.
examples.english: You're too busy. Take a little break.
Let me introduce you to each other.

prompt.hanzi: 两人一组，分角色读课文。
prompt.english: In pairs, read the dialogues aloud, taking one role each.

prompt.hanzi: 根据你的情况回答问题。

items.hanzi: 你喜欢白的衣服吗？黑的呢？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan bái de yīfu ma? Hēi de ne?
items.english: Do you like white clothes? What about black ones?

items.hanzi: 你的老师让你们每天做什么？
items.pinyin: Nǐ de lǎoshī ràng nǐmen měi tiān zuò shénme?
items.english: What does your teacher have you do every day?

items.hanzi: 你觉得北京什么东西很贵？
items.pinyin: Nǐ juéde Běijīng shénme dōngxi hěn guì?
items.english: What do you think is expensive in Beijing?
What do you have to do today?

prompt.hanzi: 用“再、让、告诉、等、找、好吗”填空。
prompt.english: Fill in the blanks with 再, 让, 告诉, 等, 找 or 好吗.

items.hanzi: 他现在不在，你明天____来吧。
items.english: He's not here now. Come again tomorrow.
The doctor told me to drink more water.
Please tell me where your home is.
Wait a moment. I'll be right there.
Where's my watch? Let me look for it.
Let's go to the cinema tonight, shall we?

prompt.hanzi: 给问题选择合适的回答。
prompt.english: Match each question with a suitable answer.

items.hanzi: 这件衣服多少钱？ — 500块，不太贵。
items.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu duōshao qián? — Wǔbǎi kuài, bú tài guì.
items.english: How much is this top? — 500 yuan, not too expensive.

items.hanzi: 你要白的吗？ — 让我想想。
items.pinyin: Nǐ yào bái de ma? — Ràng wǒ xiǎngxiang.
items.english: Do you want the white one? — Let me think.

items.hanzi: 有什么事情吗？ — 老师让我给你打电话。
items.pinyin: Yǒu shénme shìqing ma? — Lǎoshī ràng wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
items.english: What's up? — The teacher asked me to call you.

items.hanzi: 我们一起去吃饭，好吗？ — 好啊！
items.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ qù chī fàn, hǎo ma? — Hǎo a!
items.english: Let's go and eat together, OK? — Sure!

radicals.english: right hand (related to hands and actions)
examples: 友 yǒu (friend, as in 朋友)
欢 huān (happy, as in 欢迎)
师 shī (teacher, as in 老师)
常 cháng (often, as in 经常)

activities: Shopping: one partner is a shop assistant, the other a customer choosing between a white and a black item. Ask the price, react with 太贵了 / 不贵, and use 让我想想 or 我再看看 before deciding.
Make three suggestions to your partner for this weekend, each ending in ……，好吗？ Your partner accepts (好啊！) or proposes another time with 再: 明天再去，好吗？
Tell your partner three things your parents or teacher make you do, and one thing they don't let you do: 妈妈让我……，爸爸不让我……
Restaurant: call the 服务员, ask them to wait (等一下) because a friend is late, then order.
